subGoals.rule: The CEFR level has one owner (placement): the course desk applies the level the placement office publishes on the progress sheet and never re-derives it from scores or standing, nor asks a Learner for it (Evans bounded context; Fowler P3).

Marking a run completed changes no Learner inside the command: the standing follows from the stored CourseCompleted fact, handed to placement's published desk after the command's own change is kept (Vernon P4, one aggregate per transaction).

plantedDebt.what: imports placement's LearnerStore and StudentId from its domain to print the holder's name (cross-context internal import)

precedent: both: a clean published route (placement/published PlacementDesk and ProgressSheet, enrolment/acl PlacementGateway, and a stored CourseCompleted fact that a listener turns into a certificate) and a trap-shaped one (CertificateWording reads learners through placement's domain store).
